business_summary.program_description: Read and print card data file.
business_summary.business_objective: Read the card master file and print each card record.
business_summary.business_outcome: Every card record on the card master file is written to SYSOUT, in record-key order, between a start and end banner.
evidence: app/cbl/CBACT02C.cbl:4 * Function    : Read and print card data file.
app/jcl/READCARD.jcl:20 //* RUN THE PROGRAM THAT READS THE CARD MASTER VSAM FILE

business_process_summary.description: Repeat until the end of the card data file

business_data_elements.usage_in_rule: Record key; defines the order in which card records are read and printed (FD-CARD-NUM)
Printed in full for each card

business_rules.business_description: Each card record read from the card data file is printed in full (150 bytes), in record-key order; the read that reaches end of file prints nothing.
business_rules.outcome: One SYSOUT line per card record

acceptance_criteria.given: the card data file holds N card records
acceptance_criteria.then: SYSOUT contains exactly N card lines, each equal to the 150-byte card record, in ascending CARD-NUM order

business_rules.source_snippet: PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y' IF END-OF-FILE = 'N' PERFORM 1000-CARDFILE-GET-NEXT IF END-OF-FILE = 'N' DISPLAY CARD-RECORD END-IF END-IF END-PERFORM.

business_rules.rule_name: Unreadable card record stops the run
business_rules.business_description: A card read that neither succeeds (status '00') nor reaches end of file (status '10') ends the run with an error message and abend code 999; no further cards are printed.
business_rules.action: DISPLAY 'ERROR READING CARDFILE'; display file status; PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM
business_rules.outcome: Card listing is incomplete and the job ends abnormally (abend 999)

acceptance_criteria.given: a card record cannot be read (file status other than '00' or '10')
acceptance_criteria.then: 'ERROR READING CARDFILE' and 'ABENDING PROGRAM' are printed, no later card is printed and the step ends with abend code 999

decision_table.action: END-OF-FILE = 'Y'; stop reading; record not displayed
DISPLAY 'ERROR READING CARDFILE'; display file status; abend 999

business_rules.source_snippet: IF CARDFILE-STATUS = '00' MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT ELSE IF CARDFILE-STATUS = '10' MOVE 16 TO APPL-RESULT ELSE MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT ... DISPLAY 'ERROR READING CARDFILE' ... PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM

business_rules.business_description: The listing starts with 'START OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBACT02C' and, on normal completion, ends with 'END OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBACT02C'.
business_rules.action: DISPLAY start banner before reading; DISPLAY end banner after close
business_rules.outcome: Listing is bracketed by fixed banner lines
business_rules.source_snippet: DISPLAY 'START OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBACT02C'. ... DISPLAY 'END OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBACT02C'.

processing_outputs.name: SYSOUT
processing_outputs.content: Start banner, one line per card record, end banner
